test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a grammatical error. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

About the end of the month, the financial planning takes an extremely compromising turn.

options.text: About the end of the month

solution:
The correct answer is: "**About the end of the month**,".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The grammatical error in the sentence is in the introductory phrase "About the end of the month."
 
• This phrase lacks a clear subject or verb following it, making it grammatically incomplete.
 
• In a well-structured sentence, an introductory phrase should be followed by a subject and a verb to convey a complete thought.
 
• A corrected version of the sentence could be: "*At the end of the month, the financial planning takes an extremely compromising turn.*"
 
• Choose "**About**" when you want to convey a broader time frame or approximation and "**At**" when you want to specify a precise time or location.
 
• In this corrected version, the introductory phrase "At the end of the month" is followed by the subject "the financial planning" and the verb "takes," making it a grammatically complete sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**
